summary: Harlem-born barber Eligio Bishop became the social-media guru Nature Boy in 2015, leading followers across Central America while taking their money, beating women and denying medical care, until a Georgia court gave him life for rape in 2025.

evidence.note: born in Harlem in 1982; early details rely on his own unreliable accounts
alleges sexual abuse in a Queens foster home as a young child
2011 beating of partner Maisha leads to aggravated battery charge and plea deal
barbershop rants on melanin, not bathing and the evil of indoor toilets
launches the Nature Boy Facebook channel around late 2015
first group moves to a rented house in Santa Fe, Honduras
group settles in Costa Rica; Canadian missing-person case brings media attention
2017 video describing sexual behaviour around his children sparks pedophilia accusations
follower dies in Mexico in late 2018 after being discouraged from heart medication
he hits and locks up women in the group and preaches male violence
March 2022 coerced sex and revenge porn at a DeKalb County house
convicted on all counts on March 1 of the release year; life without parole

notes: Spelling of the name varies in the transcript (Alisio, Eligio); used Eligio Bishop as in Rolling Stone. Group names shift (Ethereans, Melanation, Carbon Nation); listed under the last one. Nicaragua, Panama and Hawaii deportations are brief and left out of setting. Childhood and juvenile prison segments give child-abuse; no policing theme added as the prison part is short. Main span ends at the 2025 conviction although he is alive.
